provenance: Agreement reported by the original Standards and Spec reviewers through /root/perm_review; no active-run inspection, compilation, source re-review, or reviewer record mutation was performed for this checklist.

required_sequence.evidence: Actual exit 0, complete source-policy and coverage checks, all compilation and exhaustive-audit success, matching candidate/compiler/dependencies, success record with mode fresh.
required_sequence.scope: Validates using private fresh project outputs, bypassing suspect incremental project artifacts; external dependency caches and stable-input assumptions remain trusted.

required_sequence.evidence: Separate successful normal check.sh --candidate HEAD, classified pre-build invalidations, complete compilation, successful post-build integrity guard and newly executed exhaustive audit, separate mode incremental record.
required_sequence.scope: Establishes guarded incremental recovery for this candidate and run, not historical cause or race freedom.

required_sequence.evidence: Successful LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false lake --no-cache --rehash build +ProofAudit in the pinned environment, with command, candidate, log and actual status; dependencies correspond to guarded recovery.
required_sequence.scope: Provides the managed import artifact required by the regression. Fresh private outputs do not populate this cache.

required_sequence.evidence: Unchanged scripts/test-proof-audit.py exits 0, preserving all four expected outcomes: unused external axiom accepted; private transitive forbidden axiom, private admission and unsafe declaration rejected.
Both original reviewers assess completed candidate-matched evidence, explicitly reuse unchanged source review, and provide supported dispositions of ST-002 and SP-VAL-001.
Root runs check.sh --verify-candidate HEAD immediately before acceptance and preserves success, confirming current record matches candidate, dependencies, compiler and mode.
required_sequence.scope: Does not rebuild, rerun the audit or rehash artifacts through the integrity guard.

record_handling: Preserve each successful record, command, available log, actual return code and input identities before a later candidate check removes the current record. Never restore an older record to conceal a later failure.
ST-002_acceptance_disposition_requires: Preserve the four mismatch families, prior Built evidence, subsequent mismatch diagnostics and chronology.
Disclose loss of original mismatch bytes through automatic invalidation; identify surviving/regenerated artifacts by their actual provenance.
Record capacity recovery and stable isolated-input conditions.
Obtain successful fresh verification and separately successful guarded incremental recovery.
Do not disregard any new unresolved input change, unexplained mismatch, repeated invalidation or integrity failure.
Explain the connection between recovery evidence and disposition.
permitted_eventual_disposition: Recovered or mitigated for this exact candidate under the recorded validation conditions; original mismatch creation and propagation remain unresolved.
incident_1025: Origin investigation may remain open after an independently accepted candidate recovery; do not label root cause fixed without evidence.
unresolved_even_after_recovery: Missing original artifact bytes and hashes cannot be reconstructed from regenerated files.
Creator/writer identity and whether all four mismatches shared a cause remain unknown.
No demonstrated attribution to the unknown copier, ENOSPC, or the upstream GraphEmission artifact.
No proof of absence of transient writers or race freedom.

after_all_gates: Accept Preface then Perm; immediately create and upload a complete acceptance checkpoint before advancing chapter implementation.
managed_audit_dependency_qualification: If managed +ProofAudit unexpectedly rebuilds project dependencies after guarded success, record this and re-establish corresponding guard evidence before using those changed dependencies for the regression.
